rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for physical matter, especially in scientific or explanatory contexts.

rows.note: Use this for physical material intended for making, building, or processing rather than matter in general.

example.english: The substance used to build the building must meet safety standards.
example.traditional: 起樓用嘅物料一定要符合安全標準。
